documented_exceptions.reason: FilePurpose is a closed enum: the native constructor rejects invalid-purpose before HTTP, so a type-correct snippet cannot demonstrate this HTTP 400 response.

WasmFilePurpose contains only declared members; InvalidPurpose does not exist. Accessing that absent JavaScript member yields undefined and coerces to Assistants, so it cannot demonstrate an invalid-purpose HTTP request.
